sentences: The function prints 9, so that printed number is the value coming back out.
Since printf puts 9 on the screen, m picks up that same number.
big shows 9 as its output, so assigning it to m gives m the 9.
The number printed inside the function is what reaches m in the end.
Printing b as 9 means the result of big is 9, so m becomes 9.
